styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium spring-summer casual-footwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean #FFFFFF, soft sky blue #C6E4F1 and pale blush #F8DDE1 as base fields, warm apricot #F7C9A4 as the single accent, deep charcoal #2D2D2D as the only ink color; cool-neutral bright tone at 5600K; modern geometric sans-serif for both Chinese and Latin copy, one headline plus one label per screen, no serif or handwritten faces; background system of flat matte color-block walls and simple geometric podium blocks, never random scenery or printed texture; lighting system of bright soft diffused daylight from the upper left with gentle contact shadows and no hard edges; layout system of generous margins, thin hairline rules, numbered circular markers and one callout leader style; icon system of thin single-weight line icons only, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows on icons; product presentation rules: true proportions, stable slight 3/4 or 90-degree side geometry, consistent scale and centering across all screens, both soles always grounded; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 8 片详情页切片逐片识图。源夹名仅为「鞋」这一粗粒度提示，与最终 L1 鞋靴 不冲突；按图判定主体为女款纯白低帮系带休闲板鞋（女模 + 女装搭配建议屏），故 L2 取 女鞋 而非 运动鞋。已剥离：品牌名与店铺角标、货号、产地、材质与等级表述、跟高数值、尺码建议数值、鞋身侧面印刷字符、全部原文案与英文装饰字、模特面部身份。所有文案与数值改为 {selling_point_*} / {callout_*} 占位，由下游按买家真实商品资料回填。本套件承接详情页带内嵌文案的原生形式，因此保留 textZone 与占位文案（若用于主图平台需置空）。未虚构任何检测、认证、评分、销量或功效声明。
